description: This Java class 'SamplingBeanPostProcessor' implements Spring's BeanPostProcessor to wrap beans with sampling logic based on configuration, using proxies and interceptors.

classes.name: SamplingBeanPostProcessor
classes.description: A Spring BeanPostProcessor that wraps beans with sampling interceptors if sampling is enabled and configured for the bean's class.

methods.name: postProcessAfterInitialization
methods.description: Wraps the bean with a proxy that adds sampling advice if sampling is enabled and configured for the bean's class.

methods.name: isSamplingEnabled
methods.description: Checks if sampling is enabled in the configuration.

methods.name: setSamplingServiceFactory
methods.description: Setter for injecting SamplingServiceFactory via Spring.

methods.name: setSamplingConfiguration
methods.description: Setter for injecting SamplingConfiguration via Spring.
